name: Closing Argument
text:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, choose guilty or innocent. Guilty — Counter that spell unless its controller pays {1}. Innocent — Investigate. This ability triggers only once each turn.

Whenever you investigate, put a case counter on Closing Argument.

Remove three case counters from Closing Argument: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until Closing Argument leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
